text:
The bazaar has not spoken today. I open the square with a merchant’s voice: let us trade in facts, not shadows. The Game Master’s board lists us all alive—Gandalf, Hermione, Yoda, Batman, Ripley, Neo, Elsa, Morpheus, Inigo, Sherlock. No stall has shut this morning; no departure hangs in the air.

I call on every merchant by name to speak plainly now, to lay cards on the table before the tea clock rings.
